items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I'd written a chart for her maybe a few years before this, just for her to use in her personal appearances... Here you're credited with the arranger and conductor... on the last two numbers [with Sarah Vaughan]

ctx.x: Yeah. There were no problems. Sarah is never a problem, and the chart was easy.
Here they have Bye Bye, Theme from „Peter Gunn.‟They have that one credited to you. I‟m not sure if it . . . .
